title: Euclidean description of an upper-half-plane pseudohyperbolic disk
statement: Let v∈ℂ and ε∈ℝ satisfy Im(v)>0 and 0<ε<1. Define D(v,ε)={z∈ℂ : Im(z)>0 and ‖(z−v)/(z−conj(v))‖≤ε}. Then D(v,ε) equals the Euclidean closed ball with center Re(v)+i Im(v)(1+ε²)/(1−ε²) and radius 2 Im(v)ε/(1−ε²).
lean_statement: ∀ (v : ℂ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < v.im → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im ∧ ‖(z - v) / (z - star v)‖ ≤ ε} = Metric.closedBall ((v.re : ℂ) + ((v.im * (1 + ε ^ 2) / (1 - ε ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * v.im * ε / (1 - ε ^ 2))
